tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshe g.yang 'gug pa la sbyar rgyu'i bsang mchod 'dod rgu'i sprin phung ces bya ba bzhugs so/ ༈ /bla ma nor lha'i tshogs la bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas bsang rdzas mchod gtor rnams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ dbyangs rol dang bcas/ kyai/ chos dbyings zhing kun rgyas par gang ba yi/ /bla ma rtsa gsum nor lha rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /zag med bsang mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin phung bzhes/ kyai/ sngon gyi drang srong chen po'i lugs bzhin du/ /gos dkar 'bar ba chen po'i me yi klong*/ /bzang shing sna tshogs sbyar ba'i dud sprin 'thibs/ /phye mar gangs ri ltar spungs ja chang dang*/ /bdud rtsi 'o ma'i gser skyems mtsho ltar bskyil/ /rnam mang srid dang zhi ba'i 'byor pa dang*/ /phun tshogs dpal kun dbang du byed pa yi/ /bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen sna bdun dang*/ /nye ba'i rin chen bdun dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /dpag bsam shing dang khrus rdzing skyed tshal dang*/ /rin chen sna tshogs ri bos khor yug brjid/ /lha dang klu dbang grub pa rig 'dzin dang*/ /drang srong tshogs kyis nye bar bsten pa yi/ /brag ri'i ba gam bkod legs sman shing gi/ /nags tshal nyams dga' lha mi'i me tog dang*/ /bya dang ri dwags spu sdug yid du 'ong*/ /rta g.yag ma he gnag lug la sogs pa/ /mdor na srid pa gsum gyi 'byor pa'i tshogs/ /gcig tu spungs pa'i mchod sprin chen po dang*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams mang 'phrul pa yis/ /sngo sang du ba'i lha mo yid 'phrog mas/ /zag med bde ba'i dbang po dgyes bskyed pa'i/ /'dod yon drug gi mchod pa'i rol mo ni/ /kun tu bzang po ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgyu 'phrul bsam las 'das/ /'dzad med dpag par dka' ba'i dgyes sprin 'dis/ /ma hā gu ru o rgyan tshe dpag med/ /rgyas mdzad rat+na thod phreng yab yum dang*/

/gnod sbyin gter 'chang rgya mtsho'i sde dpon ni/ /rin chen mang sprul rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /lha mo dpal dang rta bdag brgyad la sogs/ /'khor tshogs sprul par bcas pa thams cad dang*/ /byang chub sems ma nor gyi rgyun ster ma/ /rmug 'dzin dbang po la sogs nor gyi lha/ /byai ba bsam mi khyab pa thams cad la/ /bdud rtsi bsang gi mchod pa 'di 'bul lo/ /dgyes pa'i zhal bzang nyi zla ltar gsal zhing*/ /phun tshogs dge legs nor bu'i dngos grub ster/ /dbul ba'i gdung sel 'dod rgu'i 'byor pa yis/ /srid zhi'i legs tshogs dpag bsam shing ltar rgyas/ /snyan grags lha yi rol mo phyogs bcur khyab/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ /sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa'i bkra shis stsol/ /ces phye mar gser skyems mchod do/ /ces pa'ang rdor 'dzin bla ma chos grags kyis skyes dang bcas bskul ba'i bzhed skong du 'jam dbyangs blo gros rgya mtshos kaḥthog rdo rje gdan du bris pa dge legs su gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// //
